title: ceammc.seq
description: `ceammc.seq` is the ceammc library’s sequencer collection, providing objects for arpeggiation, bang and toggle sequencing, counting, Conway’s Game of Life sequencing, matrix control, timed bang output, and control-rate phasor generation. Use the specialized objects such as `seq.arp`, `seq.bangs`, `seq.counter`, or the basic `sequencer` according to the sequencing task.
